title: Agentic Context Compaction & Prefix KV Preservation Selection: Watermark Checkpoint Compaction vs. Sliding Window & Observation Masking

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Rolling FIFO Sliding-Window Drop (Pop Oldest Message Every Turn -> 0% Prefix KV Cache Hit!)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (mutating index 0 every turn invalidates 100% of Paged Prefix KV Cache!)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Unstructured LLM Summarization Every 5 Turns
tiers.recommended_scenario: Casual multi-turn chat where exact file paths and failed-attempt logs are not critical

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Stale Tool Observation Folding (Mask Outputs >8 Turns Old to Scratchpad Files)
tiers.recommended_scenario: SWE-agent style shell loops with huge stdout logs

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): 85%-Watermark Append-Only Prefix Compaction + Structured Checkpoint Schema + Scratchpad Files
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production 50+ turn Coding & Research Agents (91.5% KV Cache hit, -88.9% cost, 93.4% success)
